title: Check permissions when a security plugin cannot retrieve data
author: Marcos Nogueira
description: Troubleshoot Security Copilot plugin data retrieval failures by verifying data-plane access for the plugin's execution identity.
open_questions: What is the specific identity used by Security Copilot plugins by default, and how is it configured?
Are there any specific Azure roles recommended for common plugin data sources (e.g., Log Analytics, Resource Graph)?
How long does it typically take for permission updates to propagate in Azure?
Are there any known issues or limitations with Security Copilot plugins regarding permission scopes?
review_status: Bulk draft; automated structural checks only. Detailed source, code and visual review remains pending.

claim_support_checks.claim: Security Copilot plugins require appropriate permissions to access underlying data sources.
The plugin's ability to function depends on the permissions of the identity it uses to query the data.
